name: Malphite
notes: Malphite does one thing at a time: Seismic Shard (0.25 s) and Ground Slam (0.2419 s) have real cast times, so a cast keeps him busy until it ends (no other cast, no attack starts) and its damage lands at the moment the cast starts.

Unstoppable Force and Thunderclap have no cast time and cost nothing, but still cannot start inside another ability's cast time; Unstoppable Force is a dash so it also delays the next attack by 0.25 s (the standard cast lockout), while Thunderclap is a pure attack-modifier and delays nothing.

Unstoppable Force opens the fight at t = 0 (instant) and is recast as soon as it is off cooldown; Seismic Shard and Ground Slam are each cast on cooldown as soon as they are free, one after the other, so at most one of them lands with the opening Unstoppable Force at t = 0 and the rest follow once the earlier one's cast time has elapsed.
The dummy never deals damage, so Granite Shield never breaks: Thunderclap's passive bonus armor is treated as permanently tripled for the whole fight.

The passive's bonus armor is read as recursive (the wiki notes 'stacks with an instance of recursion'): armor_total = base_armor / (1 - 3*bonusPct), and every armor-ratio term (Thunderclap's on-hit bonus, its cone, and Ground Slam) uses this same fully-tripled, self-inclusive armor total.

Thunderclap is cast on cooldown as soon as it is up (its cooldown starts on cast, per the ability's note, and it has no cast time of its own). Its next basic attack within 6 s takes the empowered on-hit bonus and resets the attack timer; every basic attack within 5 s of the cast, including that same attack, also gets the separate cone-splash on-hit. Neither on-hit instance is treated as capable of critically striking, matching the wiki text (only the flat AD attack damage crits).
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
